payments.title: Payments
payments.recordHelp: Recording a payment never moves money. Record only money already received.
payments.pending: This request has not been settled. Send the same request again to recover its result.
payments.discardHelp: An earlier attempt may already have succeeded. Check the payment history or the client account before discarding this request. Discarding does not undo a recorded payment, allocation or refund.
payments.recordedCredit: The payment was recorded. Until an allocation succeeds, it stays as the client's credit.
payments.refundHelp: Record money already paid back. This does not send money or instruct a bank.
payments.applyElsewhere: Apply the remaining credit to another invoice on the client account.

errors.refunded: This payment has recorded refunds. Void its refunds first.
errors.overAllocation: The amount exceeds the available credit or invoice balance on one or more dates. Reload the account and check the amount and date.
errors.notAllocatable: The source or invoice can no longer be allocated. They must belong to the same client and currency, with an issued invoice and an available source. Reload and choose again.
errors.keyReused: This request key was already used with different details. Reload to check the records before starting another attempt.
errors.amount: Enter a positive amount with no more than two decimal places.
errors.date: The date must be a real date, no later than today and no earlier than the source.
errors.reversed: This allocation has already been reversed. Reload to see its current state.
errors.notRecorded: This payment or refund is already voided. Reload to see its current state.
errors.version: This record changed. Reload before trying again.
errors.failed: The request failed. Reload and try again.
errors.unknown: The answer is missing or unreadable. The outcome is unknown. Send the same request again.
errors.storage: The browser could not save or clear the request. Nothing further will be sent until it can keep a recoverable copy. Allow local storage, then reload.
errors.fields: Enter a positive amount (up to two decimal places) and a date no later than today.
